verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Structured Streaming (incremental micro-batch and low-latency continuous processing), Lakeflow declarative pipelines with Auto Loader for ETL, and Jobs/tasks for orchestration, directly covering streams, tasks, declarative pipelines, and continuous queries. This is corroborated by extensive first-party docs on structured-streaming concepts and Lakeflow ETL pipelines, though independent hands-on validation of streaming reliability specifically is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of streaming/continuous-pipeline behavior in production beyond vendor docs.
